mentions.claim_text: He says he told them they would burn the churches in the days ahead in Europe, Canada, Toronto and America, that they would poke the church, and that old historic buildings would burn.
mentions.quote: They're going to burn the churches in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of church arson across those regions.
mentions.falsify_miss: Arson rates stay at their long term level.

mentions.claim_text: He points to France as what the Lord showed was coming, says there will be a lot of them and especially in Toronto, and that people were burning things in New York City the previous night.
mentions.quote: They're going to burn a lot of churches in Toronto
mentions.falsify_match: Multiple church fires in Toronto specifically.

mentions.claim_text: He says one fire is not what he saw, that he saw a lot of fires and major buildings burning in New York with people rioting, and that they will keep praying over it.
mentions.quote: One burning is not what I saw. I saw a lot of fires
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread arson and rioting in New York.
mentions.falsify_miss: Isolated incidents only. Worth crediting that he refuses to claim the single fire as the fulfilment.

mentions.claim_text: He teaches from the cloud moving over the children of Israel, saying you had to move with it and that the blessing and the provision are where the cloud is.
mentions.quote: Provision is always there when you're
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a teaching passage.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is in contact with the young president of Brazil who wants to hold revival services in Brazil, Colombia and other Latino nations, and that the greatest harvest of souls and a major move of God is coming to South America.
mentions.quote: He's a young man and he wants to hold revival services in Brazil
mentions.falsify_match: Large scale revival meetings across South America involving Brazilian leadership.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is in Italy seeing the coast, then goes to New York and sees an event taking place there again, placing himself in Times Square at the point where the building is.
mentions.quote: I see an event taking place in New York again
mentions.falsify_match: An attack or major incident in Times Square.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is in Cuba and sees Cuba shaking, the islands shaking toward Havana and Havana shaking, with some kind of line he cannot identify and wonders whether it is from a hurricane.
mentions.quote: I see the islands shaking toward Havana
mentions.falsify_match: A damaging earthquake or hurricane at Havana.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. He offers earthquake and hurricane as alternatives without deciding.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Kennedy and that the reason he is not here any more is not simply age, that there are dark things attached.
mentions.quote: There's things that are attached that are dark
mentions.falsify_match: New information emerges about the Kennedy era.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. He corrects himself mid-sentence about who he means.

mentions.claim_text: He says an invasion is coming soon and a liberation is coming soon, that they are tying loose ends with Iran and want to do Cuba next.
mentions.quote: An invasion's coming soon. Liberation is coming soon
mentions.falsify_match: An American operation against Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says it concerns what is in the mountain, that Israel acts alone and it will make the president very angry, and that they will call it the great betrayal, with Netanyahu wanting to act.
mentions.quote: They're going to call this the great betrayal
mentions.falsify_match: An Israeli unilateral strike that ruptures relations and is publicly called a betrayal.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has to go deeper into the water to hear it, and that he sees the president wanting to act and tie up loose ends so he can go after Cuba, wanting it now but held by loose ends elsewhere.
mentions.quote: I see Trump wanting to act and tie up loose ends
mentions.falsify_match: American action against Cuba after the Iran matter closes.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that an invasion is coming soon and a liberation is coming, that the devil has had a stronghold, that the witchcraft is breaking off the island and a major move of God is about to come.
mentions.quote: the witchcraft is breaking off of the island
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuban religious movement following a change of government.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said they will be free, that this will be a free people with a financial and trade blessing on them, and that the pain of the past will be broken off them.
mentions.quote: there'll be financial trade blessing on them
mentions.falsify_match: Cuba opens economically with trade normalisation.

mentions.claim_text: He prays covering over the vice president, his wife and children, over the secretary of state and even over Erica, declaring no weapon formed against them will prosper.
mentions.quote: and even over Erica. We thank you, Lord, that they are all covered
mentions.falsify_match: A threat against one of the named people.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Erica is named here as a real person alongside serving officials, which fixes the earlier visitation as being about someone identifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the Turkish president saying Israeli attacks on Syria and Lebanon have reached the point where they threaten Turkey too, and that they will not tolerate attacks by their brothers against their brothers.
mentions.quote: they threaten not only these brotherly countries but also Turkey
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey intervenes militarily against Israel over Syria.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Turkey really coming to the defence of Syria in the days ahead, and an uprising of Putin, Xi Jinping and North Korea against what is wanted with the United States currency.
mentions.quote: I saw Turkey really coming to the defense of Syria in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Turkish military action defending Syria against Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was in the meeting and heard them discussing that they were done playing the cat and mouse game, heard unconventional weapons of war like never seen before being used by Putin, and saw Turkey involved in blocking.
mentions.quote: they were done playing the cat and mouse game
mentions.falsify_match: Russia uses a weapon type it has not used before.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man is very evil, a liar and two faced against the decision he made and what he says to the president, that the Islamic Brotherhood is in his pocket, and that a great escalation of Ezekiel 38 is coming with Turkey.
mentions.quote: I saw the Islamic Brotherhood in his pocket
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey turns openly against American and Israeli interests.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man is two faced and evil and the president needs to watch out for him, the same with the Saudi crown prince, and that Turkey comes against Israel with Syria, with Syria struck and Damascus becoming a ruinous heap.
mentions.quote: SYRIA WILL BE STRIKE AND DAMASCUS WILL BECOME A ruinous heap
mentions.falsify_match: Damascus is destroyed.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. This is Isaiah 17, so the language is scriptural rather than newly given.

mentions.claim_text: He says this will be the hook in the jaw with Russia and Iran, and repeats that he told them about Syria, Damascus and the biological weapons that will come against Israel, with Turkey coming to defend.
mentions.quote: This will be the hook in the jaw
mentions.falsify_match: A Russia led coalition moves against Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when Syria is touched in the days ahead they will all come to its defence, and that Iran was an unwanted stepchild nobody much cared about.
mentions.quote: Iran was an unwanted stepchild
mentions.falsify_match: A regional coalition forms in defence of Syria that did not form for Iran.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw invasions with the red hats, an uprising, a world war and Turkey beating their drums, and that these were visions he had over three years ago.
mentions.quote: this was visions I've had over three years ago
mentions.falsify_match: A recording from 2023 shows the same content.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such recording. He asserts the age of the vision rather than replaying it.

mentions.claim_text: He hears a taunt addressed to the president: who will you save, one, two, three, you cannot do all of them, we stretch you too thin for the enemy within, we have infiltrated your land.
mentions.quote: Who will you save? We stretch you too thin
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous crises overstretch American forces.

mentions.claim_text: He says the North Korean leader will jump in on this and become a real player because he wants to flex since he has nuclear weapons, which he says is why he called him a social pariah nobody wanted to deal with.
mentions.quote: he wants to flex because he has nuclear
mentions.falsify_match: North Korea takes a prominent role in the wider conflict.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is because of BRICS, that weakening it put a kink in the hose, that they had wanted him for the oil and the financial side and are angry that he took that away.
mentions.quote: You weaken the bricks. It tries to put a kink in the hose
mentions.falsify_match: BRICS loses momentum on a dollar alternative.

mentions.claim_text: He restates a device on a barge on the Mississippi with a makeshift floor that raised up, an electromagnetic pulse weapon fired out of the Gulf that went over the nation but did not get high enough, and that the Lord said to watch the summer months.
mentions.quote: an EMP that was shot off out of the Gulf and did not get
mentions.falsify_match: An electromagnetic pulse weapon is fired from the Gulf.

mentions.claim_text: He describes them planting trees and having fun together, says they will build an alliance with Putin around the side and Turkey rising, and hears we will stretch you too thin, with the North Korean leader sitting in a chair.
mentions.quote: we will stretch you too thin Trump
mentions.falsify_match: A visible alliance of those states acting together.

mentions.claim_text: He says they must watch the rivers, that the Lord said there is an enemy within who invaded the land by the thousands, that it is not just Iran but China with secret cells, and calls it a red dawn experience.
mentions.quote: They have invaded your land
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated attack from cells already inside America.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch what happens when Cuba gets involved and when they take Cuba, and that he sees surprise attacks coming from Cuba.
mentions.quote: I see surprise attacks coming from Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: An attack originating from Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when it is over oil will drop back to where it was before, and notes a commentator saying oil should be two hundred to two hundred and fifty dollars a barrel right now.
mentions.quote: When it's over, you will see oil drop to where it was before
mentions.falsify_match: Oil falls back to pre-crisis levels after the conflict.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. This is the opposite direction from his standing oil-200-barrel claim, and both are on record.

mentions.claim_text: He says he could hear church bells ringing throughout the land with the glory of the Lord rising on the churches as they rang, and people in Europe singing.
mentions.quote: I could hear the church bells ringing all throughout the land
mentions.falsify_match: A European church revival.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the glory rising on the church and a major harvest of souls through the bells ringing, and remarks that there was so much in the visions the night before.
mentions.quote: I saw a major harvest of souls through the church bells ringing
mentions.falsify_match: Mass conversions in Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He says a web was being made throughout Europe, then describes women in China with painted faces wearing kimono dresses, saying it was symbolic and that things were happening.
mentions.quote: these women in China that had painted faces
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Kimono is Japanese rather than Chinese dress, which he does not remark on.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the secret meetings, then plays the Ukrainian president saying they must use every opportunity for diplomacy and that he does not want to agree or disagree with the American president.
mentions.quote: I saw secret meetings. I saw the meetings
mentions.falsify_match: Secret negotiations are later confirmed.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the Ukrainian president saying Putin is lying and playing games with the White House and American society, and remarks that everybody has bad governments and that they pray for the people.
mentions.quote: Putin is lying. He play games with you with white house
mentions.falsify_match: Russian bad faith in negotiations is demonstrated.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Canada and repeats the phrase in the bus many times, then says it is about a plant on the Mississippi and that they must listen.
mentions.quote: It's about a plant on the Mississippi. You must listen
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at an industrial plant on the Mississippi.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. No plant is named and no meaning is given for the bus.

mentions.claim_text: He changes direction to pray over the president and the valley of decision concerning Iran, saying he sees Iran right now.
mentions.quote: Let's pray over President Trump's and the Valley of Decision concerning Iran
mentions.falsify_match: A decisive presidential choice on Iran follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is about how Israel handles this, that this is why named ministers are in Israel now, and that what is about to happen is over the next twenty four hours, praying over the decisions.
mentions.quote: what's about to happen over this next 24 hours
mentions.falsify_match: A decisive Israeli action within twenty four hours.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the Ukrainian president, a plane and a storm still over Europe, and as he flies in low in the spirit sees a B-2 bomber coming in low.
mentions.quote: I see a B2 bomber coming in low
mentions.falsify_match: American strategic bombers deploy over Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He argues from the coin in the fish's mouth that if God did it once he will do it again, and says he wants new carpet and a new paint job for the building for the revival that is about to take place.
mentions.quote: If he did it once, he'll do it again
mentions.falsify_match: The building work is funded.

mentions.claim_text: He says God did not leave the nation without prayer warriors and told him to pray for the president, and that he has a lot of words concerning his health and his mental state.
mentions.quote: concerning his health, concerning his mental
mentions.falsify_match: A presidential health or cognitive event.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He says he holds words he is not giving.

mentions.claim_text: He says his main focus is making sure the president completes his mission, and that he told them the twenty fifth amendment was what they were after and that they want to overthrow him with a coup.
mentions.quote: that 25th Amendment was what they were after
mentions.falsify_match: A twenty fifth amendment removal effort is attempted.

mentions.claim_text: He notes footage of the president appearing to fall asleep at a basketball game with commentators saying he is not fit for office, and contrasts it with the president having mocked his predecessor for the same thing.
mentions.quote: he made fun of Sleepy Joe and now he's not fit for office
mentions.falsify_match: A sustained public fitness campaign against the president.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them he saw a world war above Europe coming from the bankers and this man, that they will try to accelerate it, and that he saw satanic practice in Germany and Berlin.
mentions.quote: I saw World War III above Europe and it's coming from the bankers
mentions.falsify_match: A general European war.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the Ukrainian president saying that with funding they will have a competitive number to respond, six hundred or more drones and missiles, and that Russia will feel this war at home.
mentions.quote: they will fill this war like we fill, but they will fill it at home
mentions.falsify_match: Ukrainian deep strikes reach that scale.

mentions.claim_text: He notes protesting in the United Kingdom, says they are still burning things and that it is spreading from France, that it is about immigration and that they are burning buses.
mentions.quote: That's not France. It's spreading to United Kingdom now
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained immigration rioting across Britain.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is not a peace agreement because there is no peace when they are bombing, and notes named ministers with groups in Israel at that moment.
mentions.quote: that is not a peace agreement. There's no peace there
mentions.falsify_match: The ceasefire collapses.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said pray, which is why the named group is in Israel, and prays for a complete fizzling out of every plot across Israel and Jerusalem, saying he saw a major earthquake about to happen.
mentions.quote: I saw a major earthquake about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake in Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He explains the Sooners again as those who took the land ahead of time, says the Lord called it like the Boomer Sooners and that Japan will be a boomer sooner as in Oklahoma history, with Japan and South Korea taking the land.
mentions.quote: Japan will be a boomer sooner like it is with OU
mentions.falsify_match: Japan and South Korea legislate on crypto ahead of America.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of rain like nothing ever experienced, asks whether they are ready, calls it the first domino, and says he has an anticipation for the manifested presence of God.
mentions.quote: It's something you've never ever experienced. Are you ready?
mentions.falsify_match: An outpouring people describe in those terms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Rain here is figurative, so no weather outcome settles it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him he is cleaning his church now and bringing the bride to his side, cites First Corinthians 5:5, and says he had a glimpse again and was told to pray for the fourteenth.
mentions.quote: I saw again to pray for the 14th
mentions.falsify_match: Something occurs on or is prevented on 14 June.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes with nothing. This is the pre-commitment for the-14th-protected-23-in-custody, and unlike the 17 June assertion it is dated 10 June, four days before the date.

mentions.claim_text: He says that across every place holding the No Kings rally he sees faces that are blacked out, which he says is a representation rather than literal hoodies, and an underground network.
mentions.quote: I see faces that are blacked out. It's an underground network
mentions.falsify_match: An organised network is found behind the rallies.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a black widow spider weaving a web over Europe, with every single point of a nation being woven into the web, and says they must know.
mentions.quote: A black widow spider weaving a web over Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A European coalition assembled state by state that then turns.

mentions.claim_text: He hears a European song about whatever will be will be and the line the future is ours, sees a clock, and says a great distraction is coming on the clock.
mentions.quote: There's a great distraction coming on the clock
mentions.falsify_match: A major diversionary event tied to a date or a clock.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs; no date is given.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats seeing the sea, places it on Ukraine, says there is a blackness and darkness on it with Turkey, and that he sees an earthquake coming.
mentions.quote: there's a blackness and there's a darkness on this with Turkey
mentions.falsify_match: Turkish control of the Black Sea alongside a regional earthquake.
